ambiguities: The narrator receives his mother's tenderness and love directly ("elle envoyait vers moi... son amour... en un sourire qui semblait m'embrasser"), but this is the same interaction already captured by the accepted event elevating la mère du narrateur; scoring le narrateur separately for being the recipient would restate rather than add a distinct local outcome, so he is omitted. La grand-mère is mentioned only as the deceased whose loss motivates the mother's disguised mourning ("presque consolée de la mort de ma grand'mère"); this is backstory, not a local evaluative event about her, so she is omitted as well.
